privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how My Feeds ("we", "us", or "the app") collects, uses, and protects your information. By using the app, you agree to the practices described here.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.body: We collect the email address you sign in with, settings you configure (such as your default email and research agents), and, if you choose to provide them, optional API keys for third-party services (YouTube, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini). If you connect your YouTube account, we access playlist, watch history, and video data you authorize through Google's sign-in.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use your information solely to provide the app's features: monitoring channels, building your Research Feed, syncing YouTube actions you request, and running AI analysis you initiate. We do not sell your personal information.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: The app may interact with Google/YouTube, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini using credentials you provide or authorize. Your use of those services is also governed by their respective privacy policies.

storage.heading: Data Storage and Security
storage.body: Your data is stored securely in our backend. API keys are stored write-only and are never displayed back to you or read by the app after being saved.

retention.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
retention.body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You can permanently delete your account and all associated data at any time directly within the app by going to Settings and selecting "Delete Account." This removes your data — including your agents, feeds, watch history, and saved settings — and the deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone. If you prefer, or if you need assistance, you can also request deletion by emailing <mail>{{email}}</mail>, and we will complete the deletion within 30 days.

children.heading: Children's Privacy
children.body: The app is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

changes.heading: Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date above.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, contact us at <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of My Feeds ("the app"). By downloading, accessing, or using the app, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

use.heading: Use of the App
use.body: You may use the app only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these Terms. You are responsible for any activity that occurs under your account and for keeping your sign-in credentials and any API keys you provide secure.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services and Credentials
thirdParty.body: The app integrates with third-party services including YouTube/Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. You are responsible for complying with those services' terms, and for any usage, fees, or limits associated with credentials you provide.

conduct.heading: User Content and Conduct
conduct.body: You agree not to misuse the app, attempt to disrupt its operation, reverse engineer it, or use it to violate any law or third-party rights.

ip.heading: Intellectual Property
ip.body: The app and its original content, features, and functionality are owned by us and are protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

warranty.heading: Disclaimer of Warranties
warranty.body: The app is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, whether express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. We do not guarantee that the app will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that results from AI analysis will be accurate.

liability.heading: Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.

termination.heading: Termination
termination.body: We may suspend or terminate your access to the app at any time if you violate these Terms. You may stop using the app at any time and request deletion of your data by emailing <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

changes.heading: Changes to These Terms
changes.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the app after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: For questions about these Terms, contact us at <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

what.a: My Feeds lets you create collections that follow YouTube channels and other accounts, automatically surface new feeds into your Feeds, and track which feeds you've watched.

youtube.q: Do I need a YouTube account?
youtube.a: Connecting your YouTube account is optional. It lets the app sync your playlists, watch history, and video actions. You can use the core feed features without connecting.

apiKeys.q: Why do you ask for API keys?
apiKeys.a: API keys (YouTube, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) are optional and let the app fetch video data and run AI analysis on your behalf. Keys are stored securely and are never displayed back to you after saving.

storage.a: Your settings and saved keys are stored securely in our backend. API keys are write-only — once saved, they cannot be read back by the app or displayed on screen.

delete.q: How do I delete my account or data?
delete.a: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Delete Account. This permanently removes your account and all your data — your collections, feeds, watch history, and saved settings. The deletion happens immediately within the app and cannot be undone. If you have any trouble, contact us at support@travelone.ca.

help.a: Contact us any time at support@travelone.ca and we'll respond as soon as possible.
